lines: 第四章悟境
随着方羽话音落下，一道身影自入口处走了进来。
透过荧光灯，方羽看着眼前这个身穿麻衣的中年男子。
不过方羽并不认识此人。
“将方法告诉我，我可以饶你不死。”
来人看着方羽沉声开口说道，话语之中有着难以掩饰的激动。
看着方羽的目光，充满了炙热。
“饶我不死？那我倒要看看，你如何饶我不死。”
方羽看着眼前这中年人，轻笑着开口说道。
如今修为大进，他正手痒，正愁无人能够练手。
这矿坑第一层的矿奴，实力都一般，最高估计也就锻体四重。
超过锻体四重的，正常都进入更深的地方。
“不见棺材不掉泪，你一个锻体一重的废物，虽然不知道你到底是怎么抵挡这矿坑寒气的，但是你要知道这个世界上，只有拳头大才是硬道理。”
那中年人听到方羽之言，面色阴冷的开口说道。
说罢之后，中年男子身形一动，一步跨出，一拳朝着方羽的面门轰了过来。
“啪啪啪。”
拳印破空而来，三声气爆，随之响起。
那中年男子看着方羽，面露冷笑之色。
但是就在此时，方羽右手随之一动，右手成拳，朝前轰出。
“啪啪啪啪啪。”
随着这一拳轰出，虚空传来四声爆响。
两拳在空中碰撞到了一起。
中年男子如受重击，身形朝着后方倒飞了出去，直接砸在后方的岩壁之上。
一口逆血随之从其口中喷涌而出。
“怎么可能？你的实力，气爆五响，锻体五重。”
中年男子看着方羽，一脸震惊的开口说道。
方羽听到中年男子之言，漫步朝其走去。
“你要做什么？你敢杀我，我老大不会放过你的，我老大可是阎息，锻体九重巅峰的存在，在这九号矿区，就算是掌事陆玄，也要给我老大几分薄面，而且今日我来跟你，就是我老大指派的，你若是敢杀我，他必然知道是你。”
中年男子看着方羽，一脸惊恐的开口说道。
content_en:
Chapter 4 Enlightenment
As Fang Yu finished speaking, a figure walked in from the entrance.
Through the fluorescent lights, Fang Yu looked at the middle-aged man in linen in front of him.
But Fang Yu didn't know this person.
"Tell me the method and I will spare your life."
The visitor looked at Fang Yu and said in a deep voice, with unconcealable excitement in his words.
The eyes looking at Fang Yu were full of heat.
"Spare me? Then I want to see how you can spare me."
Fang Yu looked at the middle-aged man in front of him, chuckled and said.
Now that his cultivation has greatly improved, he is feeling itchy and worried that no one can practice his skills.
The mining slaves on the first floor of this mine are all average in strength, and are probably at the fourth level of body forging at best.
Anyone who exceeds the fourth level of physical training will normally go deeper.
"I won't shed tears until I see the coffin. You are a piece of trash who has been trained one weight. Although I don't know how you can withstand the cold air of this mine, but you have to know that in this world, only big fists are the last word."
The middle-aged man heard Fang Yu's words and said with a cold expression.
After saying that, the middle-aged man moved, took a step forward, and punched Fang Yu in the face.
"Bah bang bang."
The fist seal came through the air, and three bursts of energy were heard.
The middle-aged man looked at Fang Yu with a sneer on his face.
But at this moment, Fang Yu moved his right hand and formed a fist, punching forward.
"Snap, snap, snap, snap."
Following the punch, four explosions were heard in the void.
"Bang."
The two fists collided in the air.
"Bang."
As if he was hit hard, the middle-aged man flew backwards and hit the rock wall directly behind him.
"Pfft."
A mouthful of blood spurted out from his mouth.
"How is that possible? Your strength is five levels of Qi blast and five levels of body forging."
The middle-aged man looked at Fang Yu and said with a shocked expression.
Fang Yu heard the middle-aged man's words and walked towards him.
"What are you going to do? If you dare to kill me, my boss will not let you go. My boss is Yan Xi, a person at the peak of the ninth level of body forging. In this No. 9 mining area, even the boss Lu Xuan has to give my boss a little favor. And I came to you today because my boss assigned me. If you dare to kill me, he must know that it is you."
The middle-aged man looked at Fang Yu and said with a horrified look on his face.
